metadata.description: Shared conventions, guidelines, and skills for AI-assisted development on the SpaDES toolkit and LandR forest-landscape model ecosystem.

plugins.name: landr-suite
plugins.description: Skills for developing and maintaining the LandR ecosystem: module process code (cohorts, pixel groups, species/ecoregion mechanics), accessory package maintenance (LandR, LandR.CS, fireSenseUtils), and module/bookdown manuals. Builds on the SpaDES toolkit skills in spades-toolkit-suite, used by default alongside it.

plugins.name: spades-toolkit-suite
plugins.description: Skills for developing SpaDES toolkit modules, simulations, and packages in general (not LandR-specific): module anatomy and metadata, the general development workflow, per-module manuals, and toolkit package development.

plugins.name: shared-conventions
plugins.description: Ecosystem-agnostic skills used across both LandR and the SpaDES toolkit: writing and running tests, and code-level documentation (roxygen2, module metadata, NEWS).
